prompts.idle: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production BODY-ONLY intermediate for a game sprite compositor; the exact approved staff pixels will be added separately after this edit. Edit Image 1, preserving its existing four full figures, 2x2 layout, scale, camera, feet positions, helmet, chest, legs, long navy/gold wings and pose of the other arm. CHANGE ONLY THE ARM ON THE VIEWER'S LEFT in each cell. Bend that elbow comfortably, extend forearm diagonally toward screen-left/up so the CLOSED GRIPPING HAND is well outboard of torso, at lower-chest height (approximately x=28% and y=40% of each cell), thumb at top and fingers curled around a VERTICAL invisible shaft. The wrist and palm should support a standing mage's tall staff naturally. Not a punching fist, not an open hand. Keep the grip axis vertical and leave clear space directly above and below the hand. The shoulder should stay attached and relaxed. Keep other anatomy and design precisely the same, retain each cell's original non-gripping-arm action. No staff head, no long shaft, no weapon drawn: only a tiny dark grip cavity is allowed, because the immutable original staff raster is composed later. Image 2 is the approved original identity and natural staff-holding hand reference, NOT a replacement composition. No extra limbs, no aura, no orb, no UI, no text or grid. Fully transparent background with original alpha, generous space on every edge. Preserve grounded natural stance; do not create new idle sway. Sheet being edited: idle.
